headline_finding: Distinct-value count of bounded big-Phi at n=5 cap=4 across 32 states is a RULE SIGNATURE that aligns with Wolfram dynamical class. rule 90 (class 3 chaotic by orbit but linear XOR) collapses to 3 distinct Phi values via algebraic symmetry; rule 60 (class 2-like, linear) collapses to 6 distinct; rule 30 (class 3 chaotic) gives 29 distinct (near-full diversity); rule 110 (class 4 universal, Turing-complete) gives 32 distinct values (every state unique Phi). The Phi-distribution diversity is itself an information-theoretic readout of rule complexity. Bonus: 32/32 states integrate (Phi > 1.0) at every measured rule — strong state-invariant non-zero finding generalizing H_300.

H_301 extends the same methodology to all 3 other integrating panel rules: every alt-state lies inside [p25, p75] of its rule's distribution — methodology is fair-representative for all panel rules, not just rule 90. Three of the four distinct-value counts (3, 6, 29, 32) tell a coherent symmetry story matched to Wolfram class.
